title: Fable 5.2 just made the most cryptic trailer to my game
author: AkandoGames
selftext:
I wanted to test out how claude sees my game and let it create a trailer of its own. I deliberatly gave it no real instructions except that it had to be about ratiator and it decided to make it from the program's perspective ...

Here's the prompt:

  
*Now we do an experiment. go WILD and create a trailer of your liking. it can be as long or as short as you want and can have anything you want. you can use your compose skill for new music for that trailer and you can go nuts. Do whatever you want and create the trailer YOU want for ratiator. No chains here full freedom. Go crazy!*

  
If you're interested in the game I made a free tactics demo on my website.   
You can check it out here [https://akandogames.com/play/ratiator/](https://akandogames.com/play/ratiator/)

What do you guys think? Worth polishing and putting on youtube?

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/AkandoGames please update this post with more on how you used AI to build the game. A line saying it was made with AI isn't enough. Share dev details. Rule 4 is there so promotional posts add to the sub by talking about the process and real development. We don't want the sub drowned in empty promotion. Posts that aren't updated may be removed.

replies.author: AkandoGames
replies.body: the post is literally about how I used claude fable to make the trailer for the game and how it turned out .. even with the prompt. Want me to remove the demo link? This post was never meant to be promotional?!
